regression_policy.rule: A score is provisionally regressed when median loss exceeds 3% and its paired 95% interval lies below parity. No aggregate score overrides a component failure.

limitations: Selected workload subset, not the official complete Octane suite.

rss_method: Engine post-exec /proc VmHWM sampled every3ms, wait4 retained separately; avoids fork/exec parent RSS floor
hash_method: SHA-256 streamed in 1 MiB chunks before process execution; executable bytes are never retained in parent memory.
